entities.name: Kotte and Jaffna Kingdoms
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The establishment of the Kotte kingdom near modern Colombo, the independent Jaffna Kingdom of the Tamil north, the thriving cinnamon and spice trade with Arab merchants, and the Sinhalese-Tamil coexistence.
